notes.title: Closed Beta is approaching!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
We've been working hard on developing the game for the last few weeks and now we're happy to say that the new Steam Next Fest June demo is ready!

[h1][b]Now we need you![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725476/4fdfac47ef143a9522bf629fb86ce999b06d8e64.png[/img]

We're running a closed beta to collect player feedback before the Steam Next Fest starts to improve our demo.

The closed beta will have much more content than the old public demo, allowing you to see the variety and complexity of the other levels of the game. 

You will be able to play 6 levels and try some of the main Siheyuan game mechanics, the modifiers!

[list]
[*] [b]Mirrored pass:[/b] Once passed, tiles end up in the opposite area
[*] [b]Delayed pass:[/b] Once passed, tiles disappear before entering the other player’s area with a short delay.
[*] [b]Purple:[/b] Tiles are spawned mostly in purple (totally useless), possibly causing players to look for yellow tiles to erase them.
[*] [b]Yellow:[/b] Tiles are spawned mostly in yellow, possibly causing a lot of previously placed tiles to be erased.
[*] [b]Clock:[/b] Tiles can only be passed in one direction (clockwise).
[*] [b]Counter clock:[/b] Tiles can only be passed in one direction (counterclockwise).
[/list]

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/NBcFGHm7U78]Here's a new little video that teases lots of the new stuff in the game.[/url][/h3]

[h3][url=https://forms.gle/zMUDenQkRz9GQVmc6]Sign up now using this form.[/url][/h3]

And that's all for now.

See you soon!
:)
